framework_note: BACKTEST at cutoff 2024-09-01. All pentagon_jbook calls passed cutoff_date='2024-09-01'. Most likely the 21% customer is a non-DoD federal/commercial buyer (e.g., NGA commercial-imagery purchase outside the pentagon_jbook corpus, or a foreign allied government).

summary.framework_takeaway: PL at 2024-09-01 is a NON-CATCH for the J-Book Exposure Divergence pattern. The 10-K does not name specific PEs or Programs-of-Record the way IONQ/YSS did, and the J-Book corpus does not cover the NRO Commercial Systems / NGA EO commercial-imagery procurement vehicles that actually fund the EO commercial market. The framework correctly returns UNVERIFIABLE rather than a false-positive RED. The 21% single-customer concentration is the most material disclosure but the customer isn't named, so it can't be tied to a falsifiable forward-funding line in the available corpus. Two action items for the framework (not for this score): (a) extend pentagon_jbook coverage to NRO Commercial Systems Program Office + NGA-side commercial-imagery lines; (b) consider a Heuristic-extension: when a small-cap discloses an unnamed >20% concentrated customer and is in a defense/IC vertical, flag a 'CONCENTRATION_UNKNOWN' sub-signal as a lead for deeper resolution (NGA, NRO, foreign allied buyer).
